b: I'm in need of some advice. I (35F) have just found out that my husband (37M) is in love with someone else. We have been together for 18 years and married for 8.

Around 6 months ago my husband started therapy. He had told me that it was to do with issues at work and growing up. I fully supported him and straight up asked if he had any issues with me. He only signed up for 12 weeks and when the sessions ended he was happier.

I'm fully aware that I'm not perfect and have my issues, I can be very frustrating. We don't have a perfect marriage by any means, I fully admit that I probably could do more around the house, I normally do the "big" cleaning and I do the cooking. My husband does the laundry and washing up.

With it being the lead up to Christmas I have been struggling with ideas on what to get him. My husband has a tablet that I borrow to watch programs on while I work from home. It seemed like a good idea at the time to look at his search history and see if he had looked up anything in line with his interests so I could get some ideas. One of the things I found was a journal, now in september he wrote a holiday journal whilst we were on holiday and i thought it was that and I know I shouldn't have but I started to read it. It turns out it was started 2 weeks ago, he has started therapy again and on it he admits that he has feelings for a coworker and he told her about those feelings in August. She has basically cut ties with him, we have had this woman over for games nights several times and he fully lied to me about why she wasn't talking to him - some project at work he asked her to be less involved in and in reality it was because he confessed his feelings. He details how their is a hole in his life from her etc.
In this journal he says he loves me but I'm frustrating and his therapist suggested that he is acting more as a parent and maybe that's why he fell in love with the coworker.

I really don't know what to do, I can't confront him about it, he's not actually cheated on me and he wants to work on our marriage. The problem is he's not told me any of this. He's not mentioned anything that he currently does that he doesn't want to do.
I don't know how to start being a better partner without it being completely out of the blue.
